items.title: Jim Robinson Interview, 1961-07-13
items.q: I just, I left a little Jim playing the violin, understand? Just follow him.

ctx.x: I see. See, I wanted to ask you what was the first tune you ever learned to play trombone?

I think I think the first thing I learned to trombone, on freedom. I think the first thing I learned to trombone, on freedom. I think the first thing I learned to trombone, on freedom. How did you learn it? That it was, I just, I left a little Jim playing the violin, understand? Just follow him. And, and, and the most thing, for the trombone, I, I like my trombone by playing with, with the piano. The piano is to play with your foot. That's most, I started, all my trombone playing with my trombone.
